text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whew, it's shaping up pretty nicely.
—Basketball Ping-Pong!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Never heard of that.
And doesn't that have nothing to do with the 'U.A.F.'?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Wha—you're leaving ping-pong out in the cold?! Then what about hula hoops?! Bungee jumping?! Even sepak takraw wants to join the party, y'know!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
“Athletics means camaraderie, everyone's a friend—
which means,
let's do this, Jordan! A 1-on-1 showdown!”

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...I have no idea what you're talking about.
Besides, aren't you just bored of practicing anyway?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: "Besides, you really think you can beat me at basketball? Just so you know, I'm pretty tough."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ho... Impressive. The look in your eyes
completely changed the moment you got the ball.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Heh, in that case, I'll bet having to clean up after practice today on Golshi's victory.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? You're betting on Golshi?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Unfortunately, when it comes to gambling, I get the biggest thrill from betting against the odds. Make it entertaining for me, will you?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? That makes zero sense, and it's super annoying!
Just you watch, seriously~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: —Shh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clunk-clank!)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Alright, another one! Told ya so,
I'm seriously good at basketball.
How about you just admit defeat already~?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Heh... Not bad, Jordan.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Think you can stay cocky after taking this, though?!
Here it comes, Golshi-chan's special move—"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Where are you throwing that?
There's nothing up—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Where the hell are you looking! The ball is right here!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clunk-clank!)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? When did she get the ball?!
She threw it straight up... An advanced fake...?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Seriously amazing!!
You're so good at basketball!
I'm, like, totally moved—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*whiiistle*...... *ping*, *ping*, *ping*)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ?? Why is there another ball...?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I see. Threw the ball near the ceiling to draw their eyes—and instantly scored with the ball you hid, huh?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Well... you didn't spot the cheat, so you lose, Jordan.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh? What?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
He who laughs at the ball shall weep at the Strait of Gibraltar!
You learned a good lesson, Jordan!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Haaah?! Seriously, that's a foul!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I'm such an idiot for thinking she looked cool even for a second!
There's no way in hell I'm accepting this as a loss!!!
